profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. describes itself as a cloud monitoring as a service solution that lets users see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place. Its website also describes integrating security and observability to defend against AI-powered attacks, decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and execute detection and response with agentic speed.

The available material does not name specific AI products. The company's site frames its security and observability integration as a response to AI-powered attacks, but no product names are listed in the provided text.

Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, with ticker DDOG and CIK 0001561550. The company is also listed under the alias DATADOG INC - CLASS A. The company has 448 legal exposure entries in New York, and no litigation cases or MCP servers are listed for it.
